fields.description: Issue includes local political commentary and election coverage focused on Miami Beach, including discussion of mayoral and council races and criticism of proposed bar taxation and regulation. Contains columns such as "Wen's NOTEBOOK" and "THEY TELL ME," along with news notes, nightlife and entertainment listings/advertisements, radio program schedules, and sports/racing content (including "Jockey Jimmy" selections and promotion of the Bowie, Maryland race meeting). Also prints readers' letters about working conditions and wages at the Biltmore hotel and other local employment concerns, alongside assorted Miami and Miami Beach community items.
